title: kb_http.py reads a chunked POST body as empty
goal: kb_http.py answers a POST /mcp sent with Transfer-Encoding: chunked and no Content-Length either by reading the chunked body (within --max-body) or with 411 Length Required, never a 400 parse error of an empty body; a POST to a path other than /mcp reads or discards its body before the 404; test_kb_http_chunked_body proves both
